messages.subject: ShinyDash alternatives
parts:
Hello,
   I am using Shiny,  I would like to create a plot and table that gets updated as the information is generated.
   It is a very slow process and it is useful for the user to see the progress as also sometimes the algorithm gets stucked in local minima and it may be required to stop it to change parameters.

   I have been searching how to make this kind of step-by-step generated info and I have found ShinyDash, at least for plots, not sure if some of the functionality can be used for tables.

   I have seen that, apparently, based on its Github repository, is not been actively maintained and current version is 0.0.1. Also when trying to install it on Windows I have found that it is not immediate (basically because of the versions on my dev environment, that I cannot change at this moment).

    So, two questions here:

     * Is the last version of ShinyDash robust, meaning, it does well what it is supposed to do? It is not my preferred choice but may be "enough" for my humble purposes, mainly used to help me debug and profile my code.

     * Are there any other alternatives to have this kind of dynamic outputs in Shiny?

     Best regards

       Jose Magana
